nodes.statement: v2ecoli's PTS / transport functional form (saturable vs constant-bound vs linear) is unknown; mbp-01 was reframed plumbing-only because of it. Any benchmark in the glucose-decline regime stresses it. Carried prior, still load-bearing for the next iteration.

nodes.label: Mass balance when individual-cell glucose uptake rate drops to near-zero (sub...
nodes.statement: Mass balance when individual-cell glucose uptake rate drops to near-zero (substrate depletion) is unexercised by mbp-01..07. mbp-04's MassBalanceAuditor closes C/N at the population level but does not stress the low-GUR single-cell regime. Eran-flagged carried prior.

nodes.label: The mbp-02 cells_per_agent scaling (adopted 2026-05-26) washes out per-cell s...
nodes.statement: The mbp-02 cells_per_agent scaling (adopted 2026-05-26) washes out per-cell stochastic variance at large scaling factors — correct mean biology at high density, but obscures the heterogeneity that may matter for Beulig's bistable expression states. Carried prior; not stressed by mbp-05/07 evaluation.

nodes.label: HEADLINE. All coupled arms plateau ~3 orders of magnitude below the Beulig ba...
nodes.statement: HEADLINE. All coupled arms plateau ~3 orders of magnitude below the Beulig batch peak (~9.6 g/L): WCM-FBA reaches 0.026 gDW/L and Millard 0.013 gDW/L vs ~12.9 (growth verdict 'mismatch' on every card). The single-lineage / single-daughters architecture cannot accumulate population biomass to reactor scale, regardless of cell-side engine. Architectural, not a tuning gap. Caveat: graded over short/production runs (6900-9000 steps), not full Beulig-scale runs.

nodes.label: The Millard coupled arm ran 9000 steps and stayed in GENERATION 1 (generation...
nodes.statement: The Millard coupled arm ran 9000 steps and stayed in GENERATION 1 (generations_seen=[1]) while the WCM-FBA arm divided by ~2640 steps. ROOT CAUSE DIAGNOSED (2026-06-15, #225 item-5): this is INHERENT to the reduced Millard 2017 model, NOT a tuning gap. Millard 2017 is a central-carbon + energy model only (glycolysis / PPP / TCA / glyoxylate / respiration / PTS); it has NO amino-acid, nucleotide, lipid, or cell-wall biosynthesis. The FBA Metabolism it replaces supplies ALL biomass precursors. With Millard in place, the whole-cell translation/transcription machinery consumes amino-acid and NTP pools that nothing replenishes, so they drain monotonically. Measured over 80 steps (seed 0, baseline vs baseline_millard): in the FBA arm NTPs hold steady (ATP +1.4%, GTP +1.4%, CTP +1.4%) and amino acids are replenished; in the Millard arm PHE -99.5%, LEU -96.8%, VAL -50%, ARG -38%, and NTPs ATP -74% / GTP -71% / CTP -68% / UTP -24%. As precursors deplete, biomass synthesis throttles: instantaneous_growth_rate 7.3e-6/s (Millard) vs 2.15e-4/s (FBA) — ~30x slower; cell_mass accumulates +0.0005 fg/step (Millard) vs +0.238 fg/step (FBA), ~480x slower. The homeostatic-cofactor floor keeps ATP/NAD/NADP from crashing to zero (so the ODE/Equilibrium stay solvable), but amino acids and the other NTPs have no floor (correctly — Millard has no reactions making them, so flooring them would FABRICATE biology the model does not contain). NOT cleanly fixable without grafting amino-acid + nucleotide biosynthesis kinetics onto Millard (a large model-building effort) or faking precursor supply (disallowed). Documented as an inherent reduced-model limitation.

nodes.label: DIAGNOSED + RESOLVED (2026-06-15, #225 item-5). Root cause: the Millard SBML ...
nodes.statement: DIAGNOSED + RESOLVED (2026-06-15, #225 item-5). Root cause: the Millard SBML imports O2 (CYTBO) and glucose but holds HCO3 (its only CO2 form) and H2O as FIXED buffer species, so decarboxylation CO2 and respiratory H2O efflux never crossed the boundary accounting. The substrate carbon physically leaves as CO2 and the consumed O2 leaves as H2O, but only the O2/glucose UPTAKE was tracked — making uptake look like phantom mass IMPORT. Measured (baseline_millard, seed 0, 40 ticks): net boundary mass-in was +2.46 fg (vs an actual cumulative Δcell_mass of only ~+0.06 fg). FIX (implemented): reconstruct CO2 efflux from decarboxylation stoichiometry (net of GND+PDH+ICD+LPD+MAE+PCK − PPC anaplerotic re-fixation, accounted as CO2 at 44 g/mol per respiratory-quotient convention) and H2O efflux (2 H2O per CYTBO turnover), emitted to environment.exchange as medium secretion (BYPRODUCT_EFFLUX_REACTIONS in millard_pdmp_metabolism.py). The ODE is untouched (HCO3/H2O stay fixed) — only the exchange-layer accounting changed. RESULT: net boundary mass-in +2.46 → +0.09 fg, and over a sustained 100-step run the conservation gate now CLOSES — conservation_relative_cumulative 8.09 (809%) BEFORE → 0.0284 (2.84%) AFTER, a ~285x reduction that passes wcm-mass-conservation-closes-millard (in_range 0-0.05). (At 40 ticks the relative metric is still ~1.4 because the cumulative Δcell_mass denominator is tiny during the early flat/dip transient; it converges below 5% as the cell accumulates mass over ~80-100 steps.) Mass closure is now DECOUPLED from the slow-growth limitation (millard-growth-too-slow-to-divide): the cell still grows far slower than FBA and will not divide, but the boundary mass balance itself is closed.

nodes.label: The reactor does not feed dissolved-O2 back into the Millard ODE — O2 is trea...
nodes.statement: The reactor does not feed dissolved-O2 back into the Millard ODE — O2 is treated as fixed in the kinetic rate laws — so reactor aeration cannot limit Millard metabolism. The Millard arm's CTR graded 'mismatch' (0.0 vs 156.8) and OTR 'mismatch', consistent with a respiration path decoupled from reactor DO.

nodes.label: Byproduct (acetate/lactate/formate/ethanol/pyruvate/succinate) and dissolved-...
nodes.statement: Byproduct (acetate/lactate/formate/ethanol/pyruvate/succinate) and dissolved-O2 overlays are all 'ungraded' on every card: the coupled run exposes no byproduct or DO sim-concentration store for the grader to read. Half the comparison surface is dark on the sim side.

nodes.label: pbg-bioreactordesign has no fed-batch operations; the coupled runs are batch-...
nodes.statement: pbg-bioreactordesign has no fed-batch operations; the coupled runs are batch-prefix only. Reaching Beulig's 50-80 gDW/L fed-batch endpoint requires fed-batch feed operations upstream. Carried prior; routed to the upstream package (not a Beulig-scope deferral).

nodes.label: pbg-bioreactordesign#2 — the dissolved-O2 saturation has the wrong temperatur...
nodes.statement: pbg-bioreactordesign#2 — the dissolved-O2 saturation has the wrong temperature sign (masked at 298 K; biases c*(O2) high at the 310 K target). All arms compare against the same biased c* so the head-to-head is unaffected, but absolute DO magnitudes vs Beulig are biased until fixed upstream.

nodes.label: The graded runs are short/production-scope (single_daughters, 6900-9000 steps...
nodes.statement: The graded runs are short/production-scope (single_daughters, 6900-9000 steps) and reach ~3 orders below the Beulig batch peak by design (cards note 'mismatch by design — execute-and-report'). Reaching the full Beulig batch trajectory is a scope deferral pending the population runner + fed-batch.

nodes.label: The Beulig batch samples carry no acetate/lactate byproduct columns and no di...
nodes.statement: The Beulig batch samples carry no acetate/lactate byproduct columns and no dissolved-O2 reference (iML1515 card: 'no measured acetate in the Beulig batch samples'). Even with sim-side byproduct/DO stores added, these axes stay ungraded without richer reference data — a benchmark-scope limit, not only a sim gap.

nodes.label: SGKO / TRP / MEL strain extensions, fed-batch phases I-IV, and transcriptiona...
nodes.statement: SGKO / TRP / MEL strain extensions, fed-batch phases I-IV, and transcriptional-state matching against the >470 Beulig transcriptomes were deferred from mbp-05. WT batch-prefix only is graded here.

nodes.label: The iML1515 genome-scale arm predicts mu from MEASURED Beulig uptake (its glu...
nodes.statement: The iML1515 genome-scale arm predicts mu from MEASURED Beulig uptake (its glucose + O2 lower bounds are SET FROM the data), so its only graded prediction is mu (R2=-8.5 vs identity over 26 solves) — a different, arguably easier test than the WCM/Millard arms, which predict the whole trajectory from first principles. Methodology caveat for any cross-arm 'winner' claim.

nodes.label: The comparison framework grades known-architectural-gap axes as 'mismatch' (e...
nodes.statement: The comparison framework grades known-architectural-gap axes as 'mismatch' (execute-and-report) rather than distinguishing 'not-yet-calibrated / architectural' from 'wrong'. The verdict taxonomy lacks a category for a deliberately sub-scale comparison, which can read as a model failure rather than a scoped limitation.
